description:
MUST HAVE: 
 5+ years development experience in a medium to large sized IT organization using: 
 XML
 Java
 .NET
 C#
 Demonstrated experience with implementing PROS PPSS pricing software
 Understand Software Development Lifecycle and release management
 Configurations
 Command line
 Managing Windows XP/7/8 server with demonstrated understanding of basic server administration such as: 
 Adding users
 File/directory permissions
 Adding/editing environment variables
 Experience with Networking concepts, primarily Internet Information Services (IIS), Tomcat,
 firewalls, and web application hosting, with a focus will be on providing Single Sign On, Database/Analysis Services communication, and general availability of the system
 Oracle database and SQL Server experience related to: 
 Database connectivity
 Analysis Services
 SQL Query development & tuning
 Talent for driving rapid decision-making with imperfect data
 Performance Tracking and Performance Tuning of Application and Database Servers
 Support the migration of changes to various Environments (test, QA, PROD)
 Applying SCF Changes and DB Changes.
 Help with Data loads and look up tables
 Respond, Analyze and resolve the application related queries(Data Issue, workflow, configuration)
 Provide solutions for configuration issues
 NICE TO HAVE: 
 Integration experience from a package software to SAP
 Knowledge of SA, PO modules under PPSS
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration:  6+ Months
